## Necessary functions

```{r}
lmm_start <- function(data, N, family){
  N_obs <- nrow(data)
  data$time_random <- data$id+N
  
  model_x <- inla(x ~ t + f(id, model = "iid2d", n=2*N) + f(time_random, t, copy = "id"), 
                  data = data %>% filter(!is.na(x)), family = family[1], 
                  control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE, link = rep(1, nrow(data %>% filter(!is.na(x))))))
  
  model_y <- inla(y ~ t + f(id, model = "iid2d", n=2*N) + f(time_random, t, copy = "id"), 
                  data = data %>% filter(!is.na(y)), family = family[3], 
                  control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE, link = rep(1, nrow(data %>% filter(!is.na(y))))))
  
  require(brinla)
  sd_x <- bri.hyperpar.summary(model_x)[2:3, 1]
  sd_y <- bri.hyperpar.summary(model_y)[2:3, 1]
  
  return(list(sd_x = sd_x, sd_y = sd_y))
}
```

```{r }
estimation_models_gaussian <- function(model_list, dataset, M, default, type, link){
  # initialization progress bar
  pb <- progress_bar$new(
    format = "[:bar] :percent :eta",
    total = length(1:M)
  )
  
  # inizialization estimation
  N <- length(unique(dataset[[1]]$id))
  start_iter <- length(model_list) + 1
  
  for (i in start_iter:M) {
    # defining the starting point of the hyperprior of the variance-covariance matrix of the random effects
    if (default) {
      vars <- list("sd_x" = c(1, 1), "sd_y" = c(1, 1))
    } else {vars <- lmm_start(dataset[[i]], N, fam)}
    
    # estimating the models
    model_list[[i]] <- jsm_new(dataset[[i]], dataset[[i]]$x, dataset[[i]]$y, "id", "t", fam, vars$sd_x, vars$sd_y, a, cores, time, link)
    
    # saving everything
    if (default) {
      save(model_list, file = paste0("models_", type, "_gaussian_", N, "default.RData"))
    } else {save(model_list, file = paste0("models_", type, "_gaussian_", N, ".RData"))}
    
    # Update the progress bar
    pb$tick()
  }
}
```

## Simulation

```{r simulations on JSM dataset}
fam <- c("gaussian", "gaussian", "gaussian")
link_function <- function(x) (x)

# models_JSM_gaussian_200 <- list()
# estimation_models_gaussian(models_JSM_gaussian_200, data_gaussian_200, M, FALSE, "JSM", link_function)

models_JSM_gaussian_200 <- get(load("models_JSM_gaussian_200.RData"))   # M JSM models with 200 patients
```

```{r summary of the simulation}
models_JSM_gaussian_200[[5]]$coeff_jsm <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(time), ncol = 5)
mat <- simplify2array(lapply(models_JSM_gaussian_200, \(x) x$coeff_jsm[, 2]))

# average value of the numerical marginal association among the simulated datasets
mean_datasets <- data.frame(t(apply(mat, 1, function(x)
  c(
    mean_int = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    lcl_int = quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ucl_int = quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)))

# real marginal effect
mean_datasets$mean_real <- real_coeff

# average values of the analytical marginal association among the simulated datasets
mat2 <- simplify2array(lapply(models_JSM_gaussian_200, \(x) x$coeff_jsm_norm[, 3]))
mean_datasets2 <- data.frame(t(apply(mat2, 1, function(x)
  c(
    mean_close = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    lcl_close = quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ucl_close = quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)))
```
```{r simulation plot}
# dataset for the plot 
data_mean <- cbind(mean_datasets, mean_datasets2)
data_mean$time <- time

# plot
plot_norm <- ggplot(data_mean, aes(x = time, y = mean_int)) +
 geom_point(aes(color = "#08519c"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = "#08519c")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = lcl_int.2.5., color = "#08519c"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ucl_int.97.5., color = "#08519c"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_real), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_real, color = "black"), linetype = "dotted", show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_close, color = "#D95F0E"), show.legend = TRUE, size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_close, color = "#D95F0E"), show.legend = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = lcl_close.2.5., color = "#D95F0E"), show.legend = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ucl_close.97.5., color = "#D95F0E"), show.legend = TRUE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Marginal effect", color = NULL) +
  theme_light() +  # Cleaner look
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),       # Increase legend text size
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(data_mean$time), max(data_mean$time), by = 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#08519c", "#D95F0E", "black"), labels = c("Numerical estimation", "Analytical estimation", "Real value"), guide = "legend") 

plot_norm
# ggsave("jsm_normal_plot.jpg", plot = plot_norm, width = 10)
```
